project_info.name: VELOX BIKE & E-BIKE CATALOG STOREFRONT
project_info.description: Premium bicycle and electric bike catalog featuring Sepeda Gunung, BMX, Sepeda Anak, Sepeda Lipat, and Sepeda Listrik with custom WhatsApp inquiry pop-out, price-hidden storefront, and comprehensive Admin Panel.

design_archetype.name: ARCHETYPE 2: THE PERFORMANCE PRO & SPORTY TACTICAL MINIMALISM
design_archetype.vibe: High-velocity tactical athletic feel, precision engineered, dark obsidian background, electric cyan/neon accents, razor-sharp card surfaces, dynamic energy.
rules: Storefront displays NO PRICES on product cards or details (prices managed only in Admin Panel).
Storefront action buttons trigger direct WhatsApp pop-out inquiry with pre-filled product name and specs.
All text content, labels, specs, and status badges MUST be in Indonesian (Bahasa Indonesia).
Floating pop-out WhatsApp button on bottom-right corner with interactive quick-inquiry window.
Admin Panel with full CRUD operations for bicycle management (including Price management, stock, specs, and image upload/URL).

instructions_to_main_agent: 1. Read this guidelines file carefully and initialize the backend API + React storefront.
2. Ensure all UI text is strictly in Indonesian (Bahasa Indonesia).
3. ABSOLUTELY DO NOT SHOW PRICES on storefront product cards or storefront product detail modals. Prices MUST only exist in Admin Panel.

4. Storefront product cards must show: Image, Category badge, Title, Stock status badge, Specifications preview (e.g. Frame Aluminum Alloy, Shimano 12-Speed), Description, 'Detail Specs' button, and 'Tanya via WhatsApp' primary button.
5. Implement floating WhatsApp pop-out widget at fixed bottom-right with animation, pre-filled inquiry generator, and direct WhatsApp redirect.
6. Build Admin Panel with login authentication simulation, comprehensive bike catalog table (showing Price in Rp, Stock, Specs, Actions), and Modal form for Add/Edit/Delete bike items.
7. Include default seed data with 8-10 high quality bikes across all 5 categories (Sepeda Gunung, BMX, Sepeda Anak, Sepeda Lipat, Sepeda Listrik) so catalog is rich out-of-the-box.
8. Ensure dark sporty theme styling with Tailwind CSS, high contrast text, cyan glow accents, crisp card borders, and smooth Sonner toast notifications.
UNIVERSAL GUIDELINES FOR MAIN AGENT:
- You tend to converge toward generic, "on distribution" outputs. In frontend design, this creates what users call the "AI slop" aesthetic. Avoid this: make creative, distinctive frontends that surprise and delight.
    - Dark colors look good when used independently without gradients. DO NOT use dark colors as gradients    
	- Don't make generic centered layouts, simplistic gradients, and uniform styling.
    - Create depth through layered design elements with z-index hierarchy
    - Use glass-morphism effects with backdrop filters (12-24px blur)   
    - You MUST NOT apply universal transition. Eg: `transition: all`. This results in breaking transforms. Always add transitions for specific interactive elements like button, input excluding transforms
    
    - You MUST NOT center align the app container, ie do not add `.App { text-align: center; }` in the css file. This disrupts the human natural reading flow of text
    
    - Always use modern button styles like pill-shaped, or sharp button with interaction animations & color relevant to the app style

   - NEVER: use AI assistant Emoji characters like 🤖🧠💭💡🔮🎯 etc for icons. 

- Every interaction needs micro-animations - hover states, transitions, parallax effects, and entrance animations. Static = dead.    
- Use 2-3x more spacing than feels comfortable. Cramped designs look cheap.
- Subtle grain textures, noise overlays, custom cursors, selection states, and loading animations: separates good from extraordinary.
- Main agent relies on these image URLs. Missing categories (especially sponsor logos) = main agent will use placeholder text which is FORBIDDEN

**Component Reuse:**
	- Prioritize using pre-existing components from src/components/ui when applicable
	- Create new components that match the style and conventions of existing components when needed
	- Examine existing components to understand the project's component patterns before creating new ones

**Toasts:**
  - Use `sonner` for toasts"
  - Sonner component are located in `/app/src/components/ui/sonner.tsx`
